claim: cell replaces only \n, so a carriage return (or \r\n) in the text stays in the table cell. Markdown treats a lone CR as a line end, so it splits the table row.
what_goes_wrong: A carriage return in a claim, what_goes_wrong, caller or file name (taken from model JSON or git paths) stays in the cell, so REPORT.md splits the table row in viewers that treat a lone CR as a line end.
fix_idea:
Replace 
,  and 
 in cell with a space, for example with re.sub on [
]+.

claim: The host `localhost` is matched case-sensitively, so `file://LOCALHOST/repo/a.py` is treated as another host and gives `//LOCALHOST/repo/a.py` instead of the local path.
what_goes_wrong: A SARIF artifact URI with host `LOCALHOST` (hosts are case-insensitive per RFC 3986/8089) is turned into the fake network path `//LOCALHOST/repo/a.py`, so the finding's file does not match the repository file.

claim: file_of_uri compares the host with 'localhost' case-sensitively, but host names are case-insensitive, so 'file://LOCALHOST/a.py' is treated as a file on another host and gives '//LOCALHOST/a.py'.
what_goes_wrong: A SARIF result whose uri is file://LOCALHOST/a.py gets the file '//LOCALHOST/a.py' instead of '/a.py', so the finding does not match the repository file and is treated as another host's file.
fix_idea: Compare parts.netloc.lower() with 'localhost' (and treat an empty host the same way).
